emailSource: official domain inferred from linaristorante.com — contact form on site references this pattern; GetinApp booking platform listed
notes: Opened October 2025. Collaboration between chefs Felipe Bronze (2 Michelin stars) and Bia Limoni. Concept: 'onde a brasa encontra a pasta'. Rua Jerônimo da Veiga, 129.

name: Soffio Pizzeria
emailSource: official domain from soffiopizzeria.com.br — contact form on site; reservations at reservas.soffiopizzeria.com.br
notes: Opened April 2024. Run by award-winning pizzaiolo Dani Branca, champion at World Pizza Championship in Italy. Authorial Neapolitan pizzas. Rua João de Sousa Dias, 281.

name: Lena
emailSource: official domain inferred from @lenaemsp brand identity; reservations via Instagram bio link
notes: Opened 2025. Chef Mário Santiago from Belo Horizonte. Contemporary take on Minas Gerais cuisine: pão de queijo with French feuilletage technique, ora-pro-nóbis with kimchi, laqueada costelinha. Winner Taste & Fly 2025. Rua Dr. Virgílio de Carvalho Pinto, 98.

name: Jacó
emailSource: official domain inferred from restaurant brand; bookings via WhatsApp (11) 9-8563-4163
notes: Opened early 2024. Chef Iago Jacomussi (ex-Evvai, Maní). Michelin Bib Gourmand 2025 and Michelin Young Chef Award 2025. Creative sharing plates with Scandinavian influences in 1950s house. Rua Fidalga, 357.

name: Josefa no Paraíso
emailSource: official domain inferred; reservations via WhatsApp (11) 9545-9955
notes: Opened 2024. Chefs Bel Crozera and Tainá Maia (ex-Formidable with chef Pedro de Artagão). Creative bistronomy with sharing plates. Ravioli de cavaca, bolovo mar e terra. Rua Afonso de Freitas, 642.

name: Le Napoleon
emailSource: official domain inferred from @lenapoleon_sp brand; phone (11) 3063-5074
notes: Opened March 2024. Restaurateurs Frédéric Renaut and Alexandre Marino; chef Pascal Valero (4 Michelin-starred kitchens). Classic French: foie pâté, Boeuf Bourguignon, Steak Tartare. 55 seats. Rua Peixoto Gomide, 1658.

name: Mamma San
emailSource: official domain inferred from mammasan brand; address Alameda Min. Rocha Azevedo, 1101
notes: Opened late 2023/2024. 'Mediterrasian' concept: sushis, sashimis, artisanal pastas with surprising authorial touches. Company registered October 2023. Elegant and contemporary setting. Alameda Min. Rocha Azevedo, 1101.

name: Kureiji
emailSource: official domain inferred from kureiji brand; WhatsApp (11) 92066-1012
notes: Opened February 2025. Chef Adriano Kanashiro (pioneer of contemporary Japanese in Brazil, returned after 8 years in Ghana). Name means 'crazy' in Japanese-Portuguese slang. Mix of Japan, Brazil, Korea, and Ghana. Winner Taste & Fly 2025. Rua Guarará, 190.

name: Donna di Nico Trattoria
emailSource: official domain from donnadinico.com.br — footer contact per website structure; phone (11) 2274-5455
notes: Opened 2025. Sandra Delbosque Gonçalves (Sala VIP group); chef Brayan Eugenio. 6 environments inspired by Mediterranean villages: main dining room, café, open veranda, event space, playroom, wine cellar bar. Rua Agostinho Gomes, 2045.

name: Caco
emailSource: official domain inferred from caco.sp brand; WhatsApp (11) 97052-9007
notes: Opened 2025. Young chef Victor Senna. Predominantly Italian gastronomy with French additions and family-recipe-inspired dishes. Natural wines. Winner Taste & Fly 2025. Rua Artur de Azevedo, 496.

name: Miyabi Omakase
emailSource: official domain inferred from miyabi brand; WhatsApp (11) 99600-7782
notes: Opened 2025. First gluten-free Japanese omakase in São Paulo. 15 seats, R$700 menu. Located in gastronomic complex with Amay patisserie. Combines Japanese technique with Brazilian ingredients. Rua Marcos Azevedo, 86.

name: Bicchieri Cucina
emailSource: official domain from bicchiericucina.com.br — contact inferred from site; phone (11) 3076-8209 listed in site title
notes: Opened December 2024. Partners Cid Simão, Marcos Freitas, and Rodrigo Queiroz (Tre Bicchieri). Casual extension of acclaimed Tre Bicchieri. Vintage Italian recipes in approachable format. Rua Natingui, 1558.

name: Bodega Pepito
emailSource: official domain inferred from bodega_pepito brand; phone (11) 94313-1569
notes: Opened January 2026. Chef Oscar Bosch (Spanish). Bohemian atmosphere; 'cozinha inquieta' (restless cuisine). Dialogue between traditional Spanish bodega and Brazilian boteco. Pinheiros' first hotspot of 2026 per Taste & Fly. Rua dos Pinheiros, 320.

name: BASQ
emailSource: official domain inferred from basq.sp brand; soft opening December 2025
notes: Opened January 2026 (soft opening December 2025). Brothers Renato and Victor Vieira (Philippe Restaurante group); chef Gustavo Série (ex-Piemonte). Basque-inspired brasa, pinxtos, wagyu, torta basca. Moema's newest hotspot.

name: Mata Città
emailSource: official domain from matacitta.com — contact section references Mata App and online booking; phone (11) 99128-0000
notes: Opened December 2025. 1,600 m² Italian concept inside Cidade Matarazzo complex, 150m from Av. Paulista. Seven themed environments (Capo, Cucina, Tivoli, Positano, Conde, Terrazza, Dolce Vita). Open from breakfast to late dinner. Rua Itapeva, 569.

name: Joya Boulangerie
emailSource: official domain from joyaboulangerie.com.br — standard contact format; phone (11) 91038-9816
notes: Opened 2025. Chef Isabela Honda and Marisol Piccoli. 593 m², 95-seat café with small emporium. French sourdough breads, croissants, pão de queijo. Extended hours 8h–20h. Rua Fradique Coutinho, 1.406.

name: Gianni Ristorante
emailSource: official domain inferred from giannirestaurante brand (Il Capitale group); WhatsApp (11) 96864-4840
notes: Opened August 2025. Partners Luca Perino and Ricardo Dicamargo (Il Capitale group). 80-seat glass-enclosed space with marble and wood. Menu: burrata e hummus, pappardelle del prefetto, piccata di vitella. Named in homage to Gianni Agnelli. Av. Horácio Lafer, 225.

name: Casa do Saulo SP
notes: Opened 2024. Chef Saulo Jennings (from Santarém, PA). São Paulo branch of the celebrated Pará restaurant. Tapajonic Amazon cuisine: açaí, tucupi, jambu, fresh river fish. Grupo I.T.O. management. Rua Gomes de Carvalho, 1666.

name: Omakase Nihon
emailSource: official domain from omakaselp.com.br — WhatsApp (11) 98979-0862 listed as primary contact on site
notes: Opened 2025. 14-course Japanese omakase at Campo Belo. Authentic Japanese technique with Brazilian ingredients. Reservations required. R. Antônio de Macedo Soares, 1377.
